cashoutRules.title: 1. Account Verification
cashoutRules.description: Before requesting your first cashout, your email must be verified. Go to customer support if you need assistance updating details.

cashoutRules.title: 2. Playthrough Requirements
cashoutRules.description: Sign-up bonuses and deposit match values carry a standard 1x playthrough requirement before funds are eligible for withdrawal requests.

cashoutRules.title: 3. Minimum & Maximum Cashouts
cashoutRules.description: The minimum cashout limit is $5. Daily maximum cashouts are capped at $5,000 for standard players. Support can raise limits for VIP accounts.

cashoutRules.title: 4. Payout Duration
cashoutRules.description: Withdrawal requests are processed instantly or within 10-15 minutes on average via digital wallets.

customCashoutRules.title: Freeplay Cashout Limit
customCashoutRules.description: Maximum cash out on $3 Free play winnings is $30.00. Excess balance is kept on hold and released upon a $10 deposit.

customCashoutRules.title: Deposit-Based Redemption Caps
customCashoutRules.description: Cashout amounts are calculated based on your total verified deposit amount for that gaming session.

customCashoutRules.title: Hold Balance Release
customCashoutRules.description: Remaining hold balances can be transferred to load coins into other games or claimed during future qualified deposits.
